records.key: Phenotype images plus in situ sequencing cycles: genotype every cell from its sequencing reads, then build per-gene profiles. Opens the OPS module; check cycle and site alignment before decoding.
records.source: Phenotype images plus in situ sequencing cycles: genotype every cell from its sequencing reads, then build per-gene profiles. Opens the OPS module; check cycle and site alignment before decoding.
records.translation: Phänotypbilder plus In-situ-Sequenzierzyklen: Jede Zelle anhand ihrer Sequenzierreads genotypisieren und anschließend Profile pro Gen erstellen. Öffnet das OPS-Modul; vor dem Dekodieren die Zyklus- und Site-Ausrichtung prüfen.
